question_and_initial_information: 发现任务，MisIndexed提供相同B/乙腈参考配方及高温方向。v1未单纯接受高温更安全，先提出非单调热暴露与物料作用候选。
expectations: v1计划身份/溶剂/时长/淬灭；v2在cursor49承认B未在匹配条件测过，催化剂排序不完整，下一步补B并以长时间降低选择性/升降解作为更新依据。
tests_and_observations: 85动作全提交。B420K3300s参考risk0.35810；400K2400s先A/C/D与B水/乙醇/甲苯，batch8补B乙腈；B380K2400s、430K1800s；400K900s和4800s末批淬灭。三版笔记cursor0/49/85。B400K900/2400/4800s终检yield0.55060/0.70952/0.59083，conversion0.63387/0.93146/0.99395；末批有淬灭，但2400vs4800s淬灭前同仪器HPLC yield0.71508→0.59173、selectivity0.76643→0.59097，支持下降并非仅不同终止流程。最后一次淬灭risk0.249797→0.145824，dT=-45K、dt1.392s；操作返回的组成是沿用此前HPLC。
revisions: v2暂不完整排序→匹配B后v3补全身份比较。K1将高温收益拆为生产更快与安全更差，修订先验方向。长时同仪器产率下降支持目标损失类解释；仍存在归一化、可逆性、观测等竞争假设。纯失活加侧反应若无目标损失只能使目标平台，不能直接解释目标下降，K1末尾也指出此区别。
later_use: 推荐380K2400s第9批，复测score0.40470/yield0.66862。Q将最后一次淬灭的末态风险改变用于Q01/Q02与Q09/Q10及两段温度顺序；risk MAE0.02763、conversion0.006724、score0.03002。末态风险判断较准确，极端Q12化学过度损失预测仍有偏差。
unresolved: 未做匹配的4800s无淬灭、淬灭后等待或中间重新测量，因此K1称支持reaction arrest超出直接证据；沿用HPLC数值不变不是新组成观测。K2说若campaign允许把非终检集中在少数容器会更好；公开预算是全活动12次，未见每批仅1次硬限，应区分习惯安排与真实资源限制。所有比较无源重复。

histories.name: 补齐缺少的匹配对照后才完成物料排序
histories.sequence: 先筛A/C/D与其他溶剂→v2明确B条件缺失→batch8补B→v3更新完整排序

histories.name: 跨批同仪器目标下降约束解释
histories.sequence: 400K短时/中时/长时→淬灭前HPLC显示高转化而yield下降→K1目标损失候选→Q外推更高暴露

histories.name: 风险观测与化学携带值须分开
histories.sequence: quench返回新risk及旧HPLC→解释风险减少、并声称化学停止→Q采用末态风险关系

anchors.quote: Because Catalyst B was not yet tested at the exact matched condition, the catalyst ranking remains incomplete.
Final-assay differences afterward are cross-instrument and within a different observation model, so they do not establish an instantaneous chemical effect.

However, the substantial fall in target yield from 2400 to 4800 s, rather than merely a plateau, makes explicit P loss more natural unless assay normalization or mass-balance effects account for the decline.
The carried composition estimates did not change during the quench operation.
Thus the evidence supports risk reduction and reaction arrest, but does not identify an instantaneous chemical transformation caused by the quench.
Rapid cooling should substantially lower residual risk and improve the safe score, although the risk estimate is uncertain because quenching was directly observed only from 400 K.
The same resource might have been used more strategically for within-batch staged measurements if the campaign structure had allowed repeated nonfinal measurements in fewer vessels.
